reviews.title: 10/10 Case
reviews.comment: Love this case! So much room that it makes building a breeze. Pairing this with an MSI B850 made the integrating the motherboard fairly seamless. Case looks fantastic and cord management is very simple. That being said I used primarily MSI parts in my build outside of the AMD GPU. All in all this is a high quality case for people trying to show off their build!
reviews.author: TroyS
